prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this firm now represents the individual injured in the sideswipe collision that occurred while the at-fault driver was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any statements or requests from your company or its agents should be routed through this firm.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured driver, along with any other policies that may apply, including umbrella or excess coverage. Please provide written confirmation of these limits within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dash camera data, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Failure to preserve this material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
